notes.title: Lumi Trek live on Steam!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UVGejQHHZ_w;full][/previewyoutube]


We're really excited to announce that our new arcade game 'Lumi Trek' now has a dedicated page on Steam.

[h2]Please add this game to your Wishlistːsteamhappyː[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363410/Lumi_Trek/



Lumi Trek is a rhythm-based casual game in which the colors of the stars can be changed by combining the three basic colors of light. Embark on a journey full of beautiful colors and great music!

[list]
[*] Red, green, blue... You only need to hit these three buttons to play.
[*] Enjoy an intuitive and creative gameplay with colorful adventure stages and great music!
[*] You can also challenge the limits of your concentration through endless challenge stages.
[/list]
